process_area.title: KYC, Customer Due Diligence & PEP/Sanctions Screening

fields.Trigger: New customer onboarding (trade/corporate) or periodic review

workflows.name: Customer KYC Tiering, Risk Scoring & Due Diligence Level Determination

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-file of "Compliance risk-scores each customer" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "AR configures KYC tier in customer master" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Under-tiered customer escapes enhanced controls; mitigated by documented risk methodology
System Touchpoints: - KYC risk-scoring engine; customer master; monitoring-rule configuration

steps.activity: Compliance risk-scores each customer: geography, business type, transaction profile, ownership; assigns low/medium/high tier
Compliance determines due-diligence level: Simplified (low), Standard (medium), Enhanced (high) per AMLA risk-based approach
AR configures KYC tier in customer master; applies transaction monitoring rules; flags for periodic review cadence

fields.Trigger: New vendor onboarding or periodic review

workflows.name: Vendor/Supplier Due Diligence, UBO Identification & Beneficial Ownership

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-collect of "collects vendor KYC" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates UBO integrity, screens against PEP/sanctions/adverse media" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "Procurement configures vendor master with KYC tier and review" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-487 (ensure controlled execution — KYC, Customer Due Diligence & PEP/Sanctions Screening (PA-86.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fraud risk**: Shell/related-party vendor enables procurement fraud; mitigated by UBO identification and screening
System Touchpoints: - Vendor onboarding workflow; UBO registry; screening integration

steps.activity: Procurement collects vendor KYC: SEC/DTI registration, financials, ownership structure; identifies Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) ≥ 25%
Compliance validates UBO integrity, screens against PEP/sanctions/adverse media; assigns vendor risk tier
Procurement configures vendor master with KYC tier and review cadence; flags high-risk vendors for enhanced controls

workflows.name: PEP (Politically Exposed Person) Screening & Enhanced Due Diligence

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-match of "match, Compliance conducts Enhanced Due Diligence" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "documents approval and rationale" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-487 (ensure controlled execution — KYC, Customer Due Diligence & PEP/Sanctions Screening (PA-86.1).)
- operational: mandatory screening and senior approval; operational: screening and senior approval
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reputational risk**: Onboarding PEP without EDD invites scrutiny; mitigated by mandatory screening and senior approval
System Touchpoints: - PEP database; EDD case file; enhanced monitoring configuration

steps.activity: Compliance screens customer/vendor/UBO against PEP database (domestic and foreign PEPs, family, close associates)
On PEP match, Compliance conducts Enhanced Due Diligence: source of wealth/funds, business rationale, senior-management approval
Compliance sets enhanced monitoring (lower thresholds, more frequent review); documents approval and rationale

fields.Trigger: Onboarding + continuous re-screening against updated lists

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "reviews potential matches" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "files STR with AMLC" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Legal risk**: Transacting with sanctioned party violates AMLA and exposes to penalty; mitigated by real-time screening and blocking
System Touchpoints: - Sanctions screening engine; match-triage workflow; AMLC STR portal

steps.activity: IT maintains sanctions screening engine with UN, OFAC, EU, AMLC, and other watchlists; runs daily batch and real-time screening
Compliance reviews potential matches (fuzzy-match triage); confirms true positive vs. false positive; escalates true positive
On confirmed match, Compliance blocks transaction/relationship; files STR with AMLC; freezes assets per sanctions requirement

workflows.name: Adverse Media, Reputation & Legal Risk Check

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records, regulatory actions" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "Compliance assesses relevance and severity of adverse findings" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validates adverse-media interpretation where complex" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-487 (ensure controlled execution — KYC, Customer Due Diligence & PEP/Sanctions Screening (PA-86.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reputational risk**: Onboarding tainted party; mitigated by adverse-media screening

steps.activity: Compliance screens adverse media (news, court records, regulatory actions) for customers/vendors/UBOs
Compliance assesses relevance and severity of adverse findings; documents decision (proceed with EDD, decline, monitor)
Legal validates adverse-media interpretation where complex; advises on legal exposure; supports decline/exit decisions

workflows.name: KYC Document Verification, TIN/BIR & SEC Registry Validation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "Compliance verifies document authenticity" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "checks provided data against government registries" (replaces manual Step 2).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fraud risk**: Forged documents; mitigated by registry validation
System Touchpoints: - BIR TIN Validation; SEC registry; KYC document repository

steps.activity: Compliance verifies document authenticity: SEC/DTI registration, BIR TIN (via TIN Validation System), mayor's permit, IDs
Compliance cross-checks provided data against government registries; flags inconsistencies for clarification
AR/Procurement stores verified documents in KYC repository; links to customer/vendor master

fields.Trigger: Periodic cycle (1/2/3 years by tier) or trigger event (ownership change, adverse media, transaction anomaly)

workflows.name: Periodic KYC Refresh, Trigger Event Re-Review & Offboarding

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "documents and re-screens" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews on trigger events" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "records per retention" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-487 (ensure controlled execution — KYC, Customer Due Diligence & PEP/Sanctions Screening (PA-86.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Staleness risk**: Outdated KYC misses risk changes; mitigated by tiered refresh cadence
System Touchpoints: - KYC refresh calendar; trigger-event monitoring; offboarding workflow

steps.activity: Compliance triggers periodic KYC refresh per tier cadence; collects updated documents and re-screens
Compliance re-reviews on trigger events (UBO change, large unusual transaction, adverse media); adjusts tier/EDD
AR/Procurement offboards customers/vendors that fail refresh or are exited; preserves records per retention

workflows.name: KYC Data Quality, Consent & Data Privacy Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "documents customer/vendor consent for KYC data collection, use, and AMLC…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "IT Security enforces role-based access to KYC repository" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validates KYC data minimization" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-487 (ensure controlled execution — KYC, Customer Due Diligence & PEP/Sanctions Screening (PA-86.1).)
- operational: consent capture and data minimization
Pain Points / Risks: - **Privacy risk**: Excessive/unconsented KYC data violates DPA; mitigated by consent capture and data minimization
System Touchpoints: - Consent management; access control/logging; DSR workflow

steps.activity: Compliance captures and documents customer/vendor consent for KYC data collection, use, and AMLC reporting per Data Privacy Act
IT Security enforces role-based access to KYC repository; logs access; protects against unauthorized use
DPO supports data-subject requests (access, correction, deletion within legal constraints); validates KYC data minimization
